style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Split-screen diptych minimalist studio composition. Left side: an uncontrolled, sprawling, interconnected assembly of multiple brushed steel modules, extended rack rails, and complex branching bays extending off the edge. Right side: a single, neatly contained anodized aluminum module securely closed by a heavy red mechanical locking latch. Both architectural structures resting on a shared weathered concrete surface under one sharp directional key light throwing long cast shadows, matte muted palette, clean hard engineered edges, generous negative space.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, watermarks, bare cubes, spheres, abstract geometry
rationale: A component assembly perfectly abstracts the 'build vs buy' architecture debate into physical structure. The split-screen diptych visually enforces the contrast between unchecked feature sprawl and a disciplined, capped system.
cue: feature list nobody agreed to stop growing
subject: split-screen modular hardware assembly contrasting sprawling racks with a locked, capped bay
core_thesis: Building internal AI platforms leads to unchecked feature sprawl because they lack the forced renewal and review boundaries of purchased tools.
core_conflict: Uncapped internal feature growth versus forced subscription renewal boundaries
composition: split-screen diptych with left-right scenario contrast
